name: Coffee Dates
source:
Coffee Dates is a passionately crafted visual novel about getting to know your oddball co-workers at a humble little coffee shop. Each one of them has their own unique ambitions that you'll get roped into, which only escalate in scale and weirdness as you progress.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384390/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Coffee Dates》是一部倾注热情制作的视觉小说，讲述你在一家朴素的小咖啡馆里，逐渐了解那些古怪同事的故事。每个人都有自己的独特抱负，而你会被卷入其中。随着故事推进，他们的目标也变得越来越宏大、越来越离奇。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384390/]Steam[/url]]
